A '''Sith Lord''' ruled on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before<ref name="Lost Knowledge" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline" /> [[Gender/Legends|He]] was betrayed by his allies, [[Death/Legends|killed]], and [[Burial/Legends|entombed]] in a [[sarcophagus]] deep inside his own [[Unidentified Sith Lord's tomb (Athiss)|temple]]. Over the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]], knowledge of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] tomb was hidden by his betrayers and became corrupted, leading to his name being lost to history.<ref name="Lost Knowledge" />

{{RPG|"[[Lost Knowledge]]"}}
Due to the incomplete records, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] a group of lore-seekers had come to believe the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] final resting place was actually a tomb of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a source of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-related knowledge. The group [[Mission to explore a tomb on Athiss|journeyed]] to Athiss to find the tomb. Once there, they battled [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] and a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side illusion]], which, using the fears and perceptions of the explorers, adopted the Sith Lord's appearance.<ref name="Lost Knowledge" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Lord was first mentioned in "[[Lost Knowledge]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure written by [[John Dunn]] and published as part of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Beta]] book. The discovery of the Sith Lord's tomb by the player characters forms a portion of the adventure. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Lost Knowledge" />
